query:
WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO equivalence_jobs (user_id, attempt_id, payload)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, attempt_id) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!" FROM inserted
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id AS "id!" FROM equivalence_jobs
         WHERE user_id = $1 AND attempt_id = $2
        LIMIT 1
